title: How Rick Toppled an Entire Galactic Empire

cuts.voiceover_text: A Citadel commander holds Summer hostage at gunpoint, certain Rick will surrender to save his granddaughter. He is dead wrong. Rick raises his plasma blaster and calmly announces he only came to kill him. Summer watches in terror as she realizes her grandfather is not bluffing.

When the commander asks why Rick does not shoot through her, Rick breaks down the ballistics with cold calculation. His first blast would liquefy Summer and merely injure his target. He openly urges the commander to execute Summer first so he can land a clean headshot. Summer screams in betrayal, but Rick does not even flinch.

Morty panics and pulls a gun on Rick, refusing to let his sister die. Rick furiously screams that he was never going to let her die and calls Morty an idiot for ruining the standoff. The commander mocks Morty for sabotaging his own family. Mid-sentence, Morty pulls the trigger and shoots Rick straight through the head.

The commander laughs at the boy and lowers his guard. In an instant, Rick leaps right back off the floor and vaporizes him on the spot. Rick reveals the entire confrontation was an old trick: a fake weapon, a staged death, and an immediate ambush. He takes the commander's clearance badge and signals the kids to move.

Rick leads the stunned kids straight into the central Citadel mainframe. Morty and Summer guess his grand strategy, asking if he will detonate nuclear warheads or disintegrate the Federation fleet. Rick brushes their ideas aside with a grin. He announces he will bring down the entire Galactic Empire with a single keystroke. Rick taps into the economic mainframe and changes the value of their currency from a one to a zero.

Across the galaxy at Federation headquarters, emergency alarms blare as the currency crashes to zero. The president frantically tries to declare martial law, but the armed guards refuse to fight for free. Riots erupt in seconds as officials demand money just to speak. One desperate bureaucrat shoots himself in broad daylight, and citizens tear off their clothes in total frenzy. In moments, the entire empire dissolves into pure chaos.
